desc: 深绿庭荫木栏加叶影斑光的直身双手柄奶瓶，八屏留白式详情
leaf: 直身双手柄透明瓶身宽口径带罩盖奶瓶
name: 庭荫木栏直身双手柄奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用深绿庭荫与斑驳叶影把双手柄直身透明瓶身的整体轮廓一眼交代清楚，靠木栏真实尺度与暖斑光抢首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一叶影留白带放一条中文主标与一条发丝线，线下副标前置一枚细枝芽标记

shots.intent: 把源图四条功效图标带改写为三行纯文字选购疑问条，条目全部交给占位符与空白标签行，不复述保温、两用、专利与防呛断言
shots.textZone: 顶部一条中文标题与一条发丝线，其下三行细枝芽标记配三行空白标签位

shots.intent: 沿用源图两块互相叠压的空白档案框，改成庭荫木栏上两张互相叠压的留白卡与右立本品，保留对照骨架但绝不填内容也不虚构对手品
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照小标题与一条发丝线，两卡下方各一枚细枝芽标记与一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图母婴对喂正脸实拍改写为成人肩下取景、幼儿只露后脑且全程被托抱的庭荫看护场景，用一只水杯锚定尺度并承接情绪
低掠射微距交代坐在旋合领圈内的奶嘴与双柄根部装配关系，两枚细枝引线把材质与功效断言全部换成空白标签位
shots.textZone: 右上与左下各一枚细枝引线标签位，其上一条结构小标题

shots.intent: 以正侧 90 度交代双手柄与直身透明瓶身的轮廓语言与刻度与标签空白区，两枚细枝引线只承载占位符，杜绝尺寸材质杜撰
shots.textZone: 左侧一列：一条轮廓小标题加一条发丝线与两枚细枝引线标签位

shots.intent: 把源图两列六条打勾承诺改写为两列六行纯留白档案行加一块空白留证板，字段与数值全部留空由卖家后贴，杜绝证书与材质参数杜撰
shots.textZone: 顶部一节标题加一条发丝线，其下两列共六行细枝芽标记空白档案行，下方一整块空白留证板

shots.intent: 以同一庭荫叶影视觉左右分栏收口，空白芽线行动位只承载一条不超过八字的引导语，把转化动作交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 左部留白带放结束标题、一行细枝芽标记前的短引导语与两行空白芽线标签位

noDrift: no medical, feeding-ease or anti-colic benefit wording of any kind: no 「防呛」 「防胀气」 「不胀气」 「不吸瘪」 「锁流」 「均匀出奶」 「自动调节流量」, no valve, air-intake, negative-pressure or gas-liquid separation mechanism caption and no wording that implies a health result
no thermal or performance claim: no 「保温」 「六小时保温」 「恒温」 「一瓶两用」 「轻松断奶」 「不易吸瘪」, no hour, cycle, duration or use-mode count attached to any performance

no certification, patent, authorisation or endorsement wording and no reference artwork: no 「权威认证」 「专利认证」 「专利设计」 「专利号」, no serial string of any kind, no document frame ever filled, no seal, medal, rosette, star, shield or tick mark and no invented comparison result

no age or stage indication: no 「婴儿」 「新生儿」 「宝宝专用」 「儿童」 「萌娃」, no month or year range, no stage wording and no statement about who the product suits
no sterilisation, disinfection or heat-resistance standard: no 「蒸煮消毒不变形」 「耐高温」 「消毒不变形」 「可水煮」, no sterilisation rate, no percentage, no pathogen or organism name and no temperature figure
no origin or import claim: no 「德国进口」 「进口」 「原装进口」, no country name, no flag artwork and no manufacturer, supplier or heritage wording

no breastfeeding-equivalence or parenting-emotion wording: no 「每一口都像妈妈」 「仿真乳感」 「仿妈妈乳触感」 「宝宝不排斥」 「爱的温度不流失」, no soothing, mother-substitute or affection claim and no English overprint phrase such as 「NEW concept」 「liquid silicone nipple」

no invented numbers anywhere: no capacity in millilitres, no dimensions, no pack or piece count, no shelf life, no weight, no power or colour-temperature value on the image, no price, discount, coupon, countdown or delivery time, no sales count, rating or percentage comparison
no brand name, store name, logo, material-site watermark, corner mark, membership block such as 「加入会员」 「全店免费」, QR code or platform badge; the body label area is always one blank legible field

no feeding-infant face and no bottle at a child's mouth: any child appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, always held and fully supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down, never facing the camera, never showing eyes or mouth, and the bottle is never left unattended

no loose, unsecured, detached, hanging, exploded or cross-sectioned teat: the teat stays seated and captured inside the screwed-closed collar ring in every screen, and no hollow-layer, duct or inner channel is invented inside it
no microwave, no steam, no hot liquid or vapour touching skin, no water splash, no droplet spray and no water droplets on skin or on the product

no visual-family drift: no crimson or salmon poster blocks, no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no ceramic tile, no plain linen or fabric interior, no black table, no seamless studio sweep, no podium disc, no sphere cluster, no gradient card, no glass-and-water studio, no bright spring-green play mat, no woven storage basket, no filled circular stamp, no dotted circle, no squircle chip, no triangular pennant flag, no hairline lozenge, no crosshair, no outlined numeral, no heavy slab lettering, no mixed fonts, no recoloured product, no new colourway, no inconsistent leaf-shadow direction, no duplicated identical photo tile or repeated icon glyph
style.presentationRules: the handled bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the timber bench with the wide stepped collar ring screwed closed, the teat fully seated and captured inside it, and the clear overcap fitted wherever the reference shows it; the two symmetrical curved handle bars, the straight clear cylindrical body, the rounded base, the graduation markings along one flank, the small scattered motif marks near the lower body, the reference rose collar #EFC3C6, the rose motif marks #DE7C86 and the clear body #F3F2EC are never redrawn, recoloured, relocated or duplicated; any liner or inner wall visible through the clear body keeps exactly its reference placement and is never added or removed; the label area always reads as one blank legible field with no redrawn wording; leaf-shadow patterning stays consistent in direction and density across all screens; the product never floats without its contact shadow, is never occluded by props, one real object anchors scale inside every scene shot, and vertical lines stay strictly vertical
style.surfaceSystem: weathered grey-beige timber bench planks #8C8272 with visible open grain, hairline slat gaps, slight cupping and a faded oil edge, the bottle settling with real weight and one soft dappled shadow pooling to camera left; the clear body renders as true refraction with one narrow specular and readable graduation lines, the stepped collar and handle bars as soft matte moulded surfaces, the overcap as clean refractive transparent material, the teat as a soft elastic surface with its ribbed support base reading as real moulding, paper cards as fibre rather than plastic
